_source: CharacterSheet and UnitSize (RECONSTRUCTION 4.1, 4.8). Owner decision 2026-10-23: Shanoa and Leo are playable as well as Morris (built by U.VAN-T25); in the original only Morris was, the others by editing a field. A move set lists the actions a character can perform; every character stands, runs and falls.
_roster: Who is spawned, in order, one at each of player.json's spawn positions; [ and ] (L1 / R1) cycle through them in this order. The original spawned two Morrises (U.VAN-T25).

nameTag._about: SceneManager.DrawText (RECONSTRUCTION 6, item 4): every character's name written twice in Arial 10, centred on its x and Top-aligned, red at (X - 1, Y - 100) and then yellow at (X, Y). TextWriter's Top alignment lifts the text by its measured height * fontSize (10) * 0.4; Arial 10 measures 16 px high, so 64 px: the yellow name sits at the top of the 64 px frame and the red one 100 px above it. Drawn over every character, after all of them.

characters.name: Shanoa
characters._about: Morris's full move set. The original ships only her idle and run strips, so the other five borrow frames of her run strip (animations.json, U.VAN-T25) until real art is dropped in.

characters.name: Leo
characters._about: An FFVI field sprite with idle and run strips only: he stands, runs, jumps and falls (the jump and fall borrow his run strip's frames), and never kneels, slides or wall slides, so grid.json's structures are built for him to climb (U.VAN-T25).
